question: Which of the following is a demerit of the barter system?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Problem of storage.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

Disadvantages of Barter System

__
 
• ​**Problem of store **of value Due to absence of money in barter system, wealth was stored in terms of goods. 

 
 
• **Storing of goods **carried some problems like cost of storage, loss of value, transfer from one place to other, etc. 
 
• So, in case of commodities, it was difficult for people to store their purchasing power.
 
 
 
• **Lack of common measure **of value In barter system, there was absence of a common unit of measurement in which the value of goods and services can be measured. 
 
 
• In the absence of common unit, proper valuation was not possible.
 
 
 
• Advantages of Barter System
 
 
• ​Simplicity
 
• no risk of Hoarding
 
• Less chance of exploitation.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **Mistake Points__** 

__
 
• **​Lack of** Division of goods, ​**Lack of** Common unit of measurement, **Lack of **Double coincidence of wants and Problem of storage are a demerit of the barter system. (only Division of goods, Common unit of measurement, Double coincidence of wants are not)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Barter System**

 
 
• **​**Before the introduction of the **monetary system**, the world's barter system was a method of exchange that existed for centuries.
 
• Goods and services are exchanged in this arrangement for **goods and services.**
 
• This indicates that, using **comparable price and product estimates**, the parties exchange each other's goods directly without the use of **money.**
 
 
 
• **Characteristics of Barter System**
 
 
• **​Mutual Benefit**: The barter system was a traditional way for people to get what they need by giving them another good or service they needed.
 
• **Reciprocal**: The exchange in a barter system is reciprocal, which means that it is negotiated, and each participant receives the item they require in exchange for the item they are offering in exchange.
 
• **Absence of Money**: There is no exchange of money in this kind of deal. When there was no alternative method of payment and the economy did not accept cash, the barter system continued to function.
 
• **Informal Presence**: The barter system is currently only used on an informal basis and does not function as an official method of exchange.
 
• **Bilateral or Multilateral Trade**: The transaction may take place between two parties or among a number of parties who are in a position to provide something that the other party requires.
